gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil is modern and round, with big lowercase bowls that fill out each word. Anek Tamil sits under Galaxy, whose curves never thin anywhere, giving the heading a dense, cosmic weight.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-telugu: Galaxy draws every curve in one thick, unbroken outline, cosmic and commanding. It does loud, spaced-out drama best, while Anek Telugu does the quieter work of tall, wide bowls that stay open, clean and approachable.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anuphan: Galaxy looks cut with one fixed nib, cosmic and dense, with loose room between letters. Anuphan feels clean and unfussy next to it, with big round bowls and open curves that leave clear gaps.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-arimo: Arimo has a tall mean line and rounded letters whose terminals stay spacious. Arimo is best at quiet, steady text, while Galaxy, traced as if with a marker, is best at cosmic, commanding display.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-armata: Dense, loose and cosmic, Galaxy holds a constant, unshaded stroke through every letter. And Armata, with roomy gaps between characters and lowercase filling most of the height, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-athiti: Cosmic and commanding, Galaxy fills the top with dense lowercase and loose, generous spacing. And Athiti, approachable and contemporary, brings a high mean line and see-through s shapes, the sharpest contrast in the pair.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads neutral and approachable, with wide-set terminals on its s and clipped capitals. While Galaxy is at its best as cosmic, monoline display, Atkinson Hyperlegible is at its best carrying sans-serif reading.

Curves with no stress at all give Galaxy its cosmic, commanding look. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does the opposite job, spacing its approachable letters apart and leaving open counters to breathe into white space.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-biryani: Galaxy keeps a single unbroken line width, loose and cosmic. That makes it a commanding showpiece, while Biryani does the friendlier work of large open e eyes and uncramped small counters.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-blinker: Cosmic, dense, commanding: Galaxy keeps its line width constant across a tall lowercase band. While Galaxy commands attention, Blinker keeps text readable, with open apertures and lowercase filling most of the height.
